sn35.138:1.1: Yam bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn35.138:1.2: taṃ vo pahīnam hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || ||
sn35.138:1.4: Cakkhum bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn35.138:1.5: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || la || ||
sn35.138:1.7: sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || la || ||
sn35.138:1.9: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || 9
sn35.138:1.10: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yam imasmiṃ Jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsam taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya api nu tumhākam evam assa
sn35.138:1.11: Amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayam vā karotīti || ||
sn35.138:1.14: Na hi no etam bhante attā vā attaniyaṃ vā ti || || 10
sn35.138:1.15: Evam eva vo kho bhikkhave cakkhuṃ na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn35.138:1.16: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ ||
sn35.138:1.20: so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissatīti || || 2
